summary: Iteration 3 — Phase B (Skipper Watchdog + Crew Group Chat) + 2 UX bug fixes. Full backend + frontend testing on preview URL. 11/11 backend pytest tests pass (including live Gemini AI reply). All 4 features + 2 bug fixes verified end-to-end via Playwright on the deployed preview. No critical issues found.

issues: Cosmetic: 'Annular velocity -0 ft/min may be insufficient…' — negative zero rendered as '-0'. Consider Math.abs or normalising the sign for zero values. Not in scope for Phase B but flagging.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1000 — hey-skipper trigger regex is loose: the marker-stripping loop uses `if lower.startswith(marker) or marker in lower:` which will always execute the first iteration (marker='hey skipper' contained), then `str.replace` strips only that marker. Works but is confusingly written; consider a single regex sub. Non-blocking.
server.py:944 crew_safety_eval — swallows all rule exceptions with bare `except Exception: continue`. If a threshold lambda has a bug it will silently fail. Add logger.warning inside except.

SheetContent.jsx buildWatchdogPayload — maps by parameter label matching. If a workbook label changes case/whitespace, safety-eval will silently no-op. Consider co-locating threshold keys in the workbookData definition.
server.py file is now ~1070 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting crew/safety module into a separate router file.

CrewChat 3s polling with no since-cursor on first poll is OK, but subsequent polls should always send `?since=<last_created_at>` to avoid re-fetching 300 messages every 3s. Verify the frontend actually passes `since`.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 features + both UX bug fixes verified)
